info.name: KRISHI - Plant Master CRUD
info.description:
Plant Master table APIs for Admin Panel.

Columns: Plant Id | Name | Status | Address | GST | Module

**Base URL:** http://localhost:3000

**Auth:** Bearer Token required (login first via /api/auth/login)

query.description: Search in plant_id, plant_name, address, gst

request.description:
Add a new plant to the master table.

**Required fields:** plant_id, plant_name
**Optional fields:** status (default: true), address, gst, module (default: Breeder)

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "plant_id": "1902",
  "plant_name": "Breeder Farm Namakkal",
  "status": true,
  "address": "123, Main Road, Namakkal, Tamil Nadu",
  "gst": "33AABCU9603R1ZM",
  "module": "Breeder"
}
```

**Response (201):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Plant added successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "plant_id": "1902",
    "plant_name": "Breeder Farm Namakkal",
    "status": true,
    "address": "123, Main Road, Namakkal, Tamil Nadu",
    "gst": "33AABCU9603R1ZM",
    "module": "Breeder",
    "created_by": "admin",
    "created_at": "2026-07-06T11:30:00.000Z",
    "updated_at": "2026-07-06T11:30:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

**Error - Duplicate (409):**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Plant with ID \"1902\" already exists"
}
```

request.description:
Update any field(s) of an existing plant. Only send fields you want to update.

**Request Body (partial update):**
```json
{
  "plant_name": "Breeder Farm Namakkal - Updated",
  "address": "456, New Road, Namakkal, Tamil Nadu"
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Plant updated successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "plant_id": "1902",
    "plant_name": "Breeder Farm Namakkal - Updated",
    "status": true,
    "address": "456, New Road, Namakkal, Tamil Nadu",
    "gst": "33AABCU9603R1ZM",
    "module": "Breeder",
    "created_by": "admin",
    "created_at": "2026-07-06T11:30:00.000Z",
    "updated_at": "2026-07-06T11:35:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

Soft delete — sets status to false (plant is not actually removed from DB).

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Plant deleted successfully"
}
```
